basic_details.job_title: DMHO Ri Bhoi Immunisation Field Volunteer Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: One post of Immunisation Field Volunteer (IFV) is open under Immunisation NHM, Ri Bhoi District. The pay is Rs 12000 a month, including travelling allowance. The Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh (Government of Meghalaya), under the District Health Society, has invited applications for this post. The post is purely incentive-based and is open only to permanent residents of Ri Bhoi District. Applications must be submitted in hard copy only at NHM Room No 23 (2nd Floor) of the District Medical & Health Officer's office in Nongpoh on or before 27 November

important_dates.interview_date: To be uploaded on the website

qualification.details: Essential qualification: Any Graduate from recognized Institution, with computer knowledge – MS Office – Word / Excel / PPT. Residence: Applicants should be permanent residents of Ri Bhoi District. Other essentials: The candidate should have his/her own android phone and travel conveyance, i.e. preferably a two wheeler. The candidate should also have valid documents along with a valid driving license and valid insurance of the motorized vehicle. Desirable experience: Experience in field work with Govt./NGO/International Organizations in monitoring and supervision of National Health Programmes/Immunization/NID etc. will be preferred. Nature of engagement: The vacancy is filled purely on an incentive basis under Immunisation NHM, Ri Bhoi District. Pay: The Rs 12000 a month includes travelling allowance. The age limit is not specified in the notice. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

selection_process: All applications will be subjected to a screening process constituted for the purpose. The notice refers to a Written Test or Interview. The date
venue and time for it will be uploaded on the websites ribhoi.gov.in/dmho and ribhoi.gov.in.
Candidates who are shortlisted must produce all relevant certificates
testimonials etc. in original at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
important_instructions: Applications found incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected. For further details, see the Notice Board of the Deputy Commissioner, Ri Bhoi District / District Medical & Health Officer, Ri Bhoi District, or the websites ribhoi.gov.in/dmho and ribhoi.gov.in. If any dispute arises, the undersigned reserves the right to reject any or all applications without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: About DMHO Ri Bhoi Immunisation Field Volunteer (IFV)
content_sections.text: The Office of the District Medical & Health Officer, Ri Bhoi District, is a Government of Meghalaya health office at Nongpoh. The District Medical & Health Officer is also the Member Secretary of the District Health Society, Ri Bhoi District. This post is advertised under the National Health Mission, for Immunisation NHM in Ri Bhoi District.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: The application, with all relevant certificates and testimonials, must be submitted in hard copy only at this address: NHM Room No 23 (2nd Floor), Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh. The notice does not give a printed application form, so candidates submit their own application. The deadline is on or before 27 November 2026, up to 3:00 pm. The notice does not mention postal or email submission. An application found incomplete in any respect shall be summarily rejected.

The candidate should also have valid documents along with a valid driving license and valid insurance of the motorized vehicle. Desirable experience: Experience in field work with Govt./NGO/International Organizations in monitoring and supervision of National Health Programmes/Immunization/NID etc. will be preferred. Nature of engagement: The vacancy is filled purely on an incentive basis under Immunisation NHM, Ri Bhoi District. Pay: The Rs 12000 a month includes travelling allowance. The age limit is not specified in the notice. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there for Immunisation Field Volunteer in Ri Bhoi?
faq.answer: There is 1 post of Immunisation Field Volunteer (IFV), with the place of posting at the District DPMU, Ri Bhoi District.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must be submitted on or before 27 November 2026, up to 3:00 pm.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IFV post?
faq.answer: The candidate needs to be Any Graduate from a recognized Institution, with computer knowledge in MS Office – Word / Excel / PPT.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of an Immunisation Field Volunteer?
faq.answer: The remuneration is Rs 12000 (Twelve thousand only), including travelling allowance per month, and the post is purely incentive-based.

faq.question: Q5. Is travelling allowance paid on top of the Rs 12000?
faq.answer: No, the Rs 12000 a month already includes travelling allowance. No TA/DA is paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the DMHO Ri Bhoi IFV post?
faq.answer: Submit the application in hard copy only, with all relevant certificates and testimonials, at NHM Room No 23 (2nd Floor), Office of the District Medical & Health Officer Ri Bhoi District, Nongpoh.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Applications go through a screening process, followed by a Written Test or Interview. The date, venue and time of the test or interview will be uploaded on ribhoi.gov.in/dmho and ribhoi.gov.in.

faq.question: Q8. Who can apply for this post?
faq.answer: Only permanent residents of Ri Bhoi District can apply, and they must submit proof of residence.

faq.question: Q9. Do I need my own vehicle and phone?
faq.answer: Yes. The candidate should have his/her own android phone and travel conveyance, preferably a two wheeler, with a valid driving license and valid insurance of the motorized vehicle.
